PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 character vocabulary
https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR

The supported-character list is derived from ppocr/utils/dict/ppocrv5_dict.txt.
PaddleOCR and its model dictionary are distributed under the Apache License 2.0;
see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.

Browser inference uses the official PP-OCRv5 mobile recognition ONNX model.
The document text-region detection model is not used. ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0
executes the local model in the browser.
